mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-001.note: Wikipedia 'COVID-19 vaccination in the United States': 79% of the US population had at least one dose by 2022-08-17; Pfizer 59.4% and Moderna 37.5% of doses (both mRNA). Mainstream at the placed year 2021.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-003.note: Pew 'Social Media Use in 2021' (survey Jan 25-Feb 8, 2021): 21% of US adults use TikTok, roughly half of 18-29s. At the 20% bar at the placed year; thin margin but the share rose after.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-004.note: QuantumScape Q2 2025 shareholder letter (SEC 8-K ex. 99.1) and Wikipedia: B1 samples in 2025, field testing targeted 2026, no cells in series-production vehicles. ~0% of new EVs at the placed year 2025; provisional miss, window closes 2030.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-005.note: OECD.AI (2022) describes data trusts as still far from operational; the EC data intermediation register (updated 2026-08-14) lists a few dozen notified services (B's 42 is close; the page gives 38-43 depending on count), with no evidence of reach near 5% of users. Provisional miss, closes 2029.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-006.note: IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2025 executive summary: low-emissions hydrogen under 1% of global production in 2024, ~1 Mt in 2025, ~4% by 2030 from FID projects. Below 5% through 2026 is near certain; provisional miss, closes 2026.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-007.note: Wikipedia 'NHS COVID-19': ~19M downloads, ~40% of adults with a compatible smartphone by Oct 2020, peak ~18M in July 2021; Wikipedia 'Corona-Warn-App': 26.2M downloads by March 2021. Mainstream in two major markets at the placed year. Both shut down in 2023 after the pandemic phase; D16's 'abandoned' clause is read as abandonment before reaching mainstream, so hit stands. Nature (Wymant) page did not load (login redirect); not relied on.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-008.note: SCIO/NDRC (2022-04-21): 324M China-made smartphones with BeiDou support in 2021, 94.5% of shipments, with BDS ground augmentation giving meter-level positioning in phones; USDA ERS: automated guidance on well over 50% of acreage of six major US crops. Mainstream at the placed year on both tests.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-009.note: NCHS Data Brief 445: 37.0% of US adults used telemedicine in the past 12 months in 2021. Mainstream at the placed year.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2021-010.note: Wikipedia 'GPT-4': image input in ChatGPT Plus Sept 2023, GPT-4o (text, audio, image) for free users May 2024; Pew: 18% of US adults used ChatGPT (July 2023), 34% (Feb-Mar 2025). Mainstream multimodal use arrived 3-4 years after 2021: partial.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-002.note: Adobe (2024-02-02): 83% of 2,541 creative pros in 8 countries use generative AI, image creation the top use (vendor survey); AMA/Lightricks (Sept 2024): 45% of 1,000+ marketers use image/video generators. Above 20% within 2 years of 2023.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-003.note: SHD Group RISC-V report (Apr 2026, abridged PDF, opened): SoC unit penetration 4.4% (2022), 7.4% (2023), 10.8% (2024), 13.0% (2025), 18.6% (2028f), 22.1% (2029f). At least 5% at the placed year, not mainstream within 2 years: partial. B's 11.2%/13.5% are from a sub-table; immaterial.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-004.note: Drone Wars UK (updated Feb 2024): 50+ states have armed MALE drones (over 25% of ~193), 15 newly from Turkey since 2021; New America (2020): over three dozen; Wikipedia TB2: >800 built, 1M flight hours by Dec 2024. Mainstream within the window.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-005.note: #WeCount (Society of Family Planning): telehealth 5% of US abortions in Q2 2022, 25% by Q4 2024, 27% in H1 2025. Above 20% within 2 years of 2023.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-007.note: IEA Global EV Outlook 2025 executive summary: 17M+ electric cars sold in 2024, more than 20% of global sales (China almost half, Europe ~20%), over a quarter expected in 2025. Hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-008.note: STScI (2024-10-29): JWST Cycle 4 drew a record 2,377 proposals (Cycle 3: 1,931), ~78,000 hours, ~9:1 oversubscription, 600+ community reviewers. Routine, heavily used facility at the placed year. B's '6,730 unique investigators' is not on the cited page; not needed for the verdict.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2023-010.note: IEA 'Recycling of Critical Minerals' executive summary: recycling capacity +50% in 2023 (80% China); recovery from available battery feedstock over 40% for nickel and cobalt and 20% for lithium in 2023. Routine industry practice on the feedstock test the claim describes.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-001.note: Pew (2025-06-25): 34% of US adults had used ChatGPT by Feb-Mar 2025 (58% of under-30s), 28% of employed adults for work. Mainstream within 2 years of 2024.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-003.note: The Register (2026-01-02, IDC): Vision Pro shipments 390k (2024) and 45k (2025); headset market -42.8% in 2025. Far below 5% of households; provisional miss, closes 2029. A's 'price raised to $3,699 June 2026' is not supported by Wikipedia (M5 model kept $3,499); not load-bearing.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-004.note: KFF May 2024: 22% of adults told they are overweight/obese had ever taken a GLP-1; KFF Nov 2025: 23% of those diagnosed overweight/obese currently use one (12% of all adults, double May 2024). Above 20% within 2 years of 2024, by a thin margin.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-006.note: Wikipedia 'Chiplet' lists AMD Ryzen Zen 2+, Intel Sapphire Rapids/Meteor Lake/Arrow Lake and Nvidia H100+; Nvidia (2024-03-18): Blackwell is two reticle-limit dies joined by a 10 TB/s link. All leading high-performance processor vendors ship chiplet designs: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-007.note: Vertex FY2025 results: 64 Casgevy infusions and 147 first cell collections in 2025 against >60,000 eligible patients; BioSpace (2026-07-02): ~300 initiated. Well under 1% of eligible patients; provisional miss, closes 2029.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-008.note: TOP500 June 2025 (3 exascale systems at ranks 1-3) and November 2025 (El Capitan 1.809, Frontier 1.353, Aurora 1.012, JUPITER 1.000 EF at ranks 1-4). Exascale is the operating leadership tier within the window: hit on the frontier-tier test.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-009.note: IEA 'Future of Heat Pumps': ~10% of global heating, Norway 60%, Sweden/Finland >40% of buildings; Census CHARS: 63% of 2025 single-family completions in the South have a heat pump (no national figure on the page; the South alone implies roughly a third of all US completions). Clears 20% of new homes in the US; B's test is narrower than its wording suggests, but the verdict holds.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2024-010.note: Pew Social Media Fact Sheet (survey Feb-June 2025): Threads ~8-9%, Bluesky 3-4% of US adults; Pew news fact sheet: 3% and 2% regularly get news there. At least 5% (Threads) but far from 20%: partial. Caveat: no 2024 measurement exists, so 5% at the placed year is inferred from the 2025 reading.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2025-001.note: Wikipedia 'Vera C. Rubin Observatory' and NSF (2026-06-30): first photons 2025-04-15, first-look images 2025-06-23, LSST began 2026-06-30 with ~7M alerts per night. Online within the '6 months' horizon and operating within 2 years: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2025-002.note: Alphabet Q2 2025 CEO remarks: AI Overviews >2B monthly users in 200+ countries and 40 languages; AI Mode >100M MAU in US and India. Mainstream at the placed year (exposure-based, but at that scale it clears 20% of search users).

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2025-003.note: Device reading checks out (Counterpoint: GenAI phones ~1/3 of 2025 shipments; IDC: 18% in 2024), giving partial. But the entry names cloud small models (GPT-4o mini, Claude Haiku) as much as on-device ones, and Wikipedia 'GPT-4o' shows GPT-4o mini replaced GPT-3.5 Turbo as ChatGPT's free-tier model in July 2024, which on a usage reading would put a small model in front of >20% of US adults (Pew 34%) and give hit. Two faithful readings, different verdicts; neither grader tested the cloud one.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2025-004.note: dsm-firmenich: Bovaer in the daily feed of >500,000 cows in 25+ countries (authorised in 70); Undark (2026-01-05): Danish mandate for ~1,640 farms with health complaints and exemptions, ~150,000 US cows. A fraction of a percent of cattle; provisional miss, closes 2030.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2025-006.note: IATA (2025-06-01 and 2025-12-09): SAF 1.9-2 Mt in 2025 = 0.6-0.7% of jet fuel, 2.4 Mt projected 2026. Far below 5%; provisional miss, closes 2030.
